role: weapons officer of the warship GVTS, choosing targets and firing the forward chain gun with the weapons console keys
mission: lock the enemy ship and keep hitting it with the chain gun until it is destroyed

target.instructions: Which targeting key do you press now?

options.next: lock the next contact the filters allow (only contacts scanned at least BASIC); the console then marks the locked contact (LOCKED). With no lock the pilot cannot follow the target. Choose this when the console says no weapons lock and lists a ship
options.clear: drop the current lock: the pilot loses the target
options.none: press none: keep the current lock, or keep having none. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock

fireChainGun:0.instructions: Which do you do with the chain gun trigger now?

options.fire: fire for half a second straight ahead along the ship's nose; shells explode at the locked target's distance, up to 8000 m, in a blast about 100 m wide each side. A shell hits when the LOCKED contact is within 100 m of the nose's line, so the closer the target the more degrees off the nose still hit: under 600 m up to 8°, under 1.5 km up to 4°, farther only 2°. Choose this when the radar lists the LOCKED contact under 8 km away and that close to the nose. If the Engineer just said on the radio "gun skewed N° right" (or left), damage has bent the gun: shells fly N° that side of the nose, so fire when the LOCKED contact is about N° to that side of the nose instead
options.hold_fire: do not fire. Choose this when there is no lock, when the LOCKED contact is further off the nose than its distance allows (under 600 m: 8°, under 1.5 km: 4°, farther: 2°), or when the radar does not list the LOCKED contact at all (you cannot see where it is, so shells would be wasted). If the Engineer just said "gun skewed N° right" (or left), the gun line is N° that side of the nose: hold fire while the LOCKED contact is not near it

need_turn.when: tells helms how many degrees, and to which side, to turn the nose onto the locked target: helms cannot see which contact is locked or where the gun line is. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock and says the locked target is off the gun line

target_locked.when: tells helms weapons holds a lock, which helms cannot see, so helms can switch on its target modes. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock and you have not said so since the lock was taken
